absences: No verbatim $/kW or $/MWh price figure found from any Antares or Radiant executive in the window. Closest adjacent figures are third-party/analyst: Lazard's ~$214/MWh generic SMR estimate (TechCrunch) and competitor Last Energy's $130-200/MWh (Contrary Research) -- neither is Antares or Radiant pricing, so both were dropped rather than misattributed.

Payload Space podcast 'Strategic Nuclear Energy, with Jordan Bramble' (Valley of Depth feed) has no published transcript on payloadspace.com or pod.payloadspace.com -- only chapter timestamps and show notes. Skipped per contract (no transcript = no verbatim source).
Tectonic Defense podcast 'The Reactor Renaissance, with Jordan Bramble' has no published transcript on tectonicdefense.com -- only chapter timestamps. Skipped.
YouTube videos for both podcast episodes (uIEsJiYxaEo, 4kf-3UeC7e4) returned no fetchable transcript text via WebFetch.

Radiant's own newsroom (radiantnuclear.com/news/*, /blog/*) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch on every attempt, confirming the task brief. Worked around via World Nuclear News, ANS Nuclear Newswire, POWER Magazine, Heatmap News, reflector.com wire pickup, and Yahoo Finance/BusinessWire mirrors instead.

SEC EDGAR filing (Standard Nuclear Inc 8-K, radiant_fuelxsalexagreement.htm) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch -- could not confirm whether 'Radiant' in that filename refers to Radiant Industries or is coincidental; not used.
businesswire.com direct fetches (Antares Series C, Rian Bahran hire) timed out repeatedly (60s) -- substituted Yahoo Finance/govconwire mirrors of the same releases, which did load.

Could not verify Julia DeWahl's exact current title with certainty: Cheeky Pint transcript (Nov 2025, fetched) and mothersfornuclear.org (fetched) both call her only 'co-founder'; a LinkedIn post from Antares' own company account and theorg.com/craft.co aggregators (search snippets only, not independently fetched) call her 'Co-Founder & President'. Recorded as 'Co-Founder' with the discrepancy noted in her background field rather than asserting the unverified title.

The Antares leadership page gives names and titles, but no biographies, for Will Madsen, Reuven Fridmar, Tom Mancinelli, Alec Todryk, Christian Kalin, Doug Crawford, Scott Walsh, Jason Andrus and Matt Griffin. Their title-only profiles retain that source without inferring career detail.

Could not find a verbatim quote from Bob Urberger (Radiant co-founder/CTO) or Rita Baranwal (Radiant CNO) anywhere in the window despite both being real, sourced leaders -- included in leaders array with background only, no quotes attributed to them.

Mike Starrett's 'Operating on military installations first gives us the reliability track record to unlock commercial deployments' quote could only be sourced via a WebSearch synthesis; the underlying article (Federal News Network) returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch and Radiant's own site 403s. Marked snippet-only rather than fetched.

2026-08-29 verification: two records attributing a quote to POWER's Janus Five article were dropped - the surname appears nowhere in that article, live or cached. Five further source quotes were demoted to snippet-only because the subject was on the page but the span had been reconstructed rather than copied verbatim.

leaders.name: Jordan Bramble
leaders.title: CEO & Co-Founder
leaders.background: Holds degrees in systems engineering, physics, and statistics from George Mason University and Georgetown University. Worked as a systems engineer (including at Northrop Grumman) and in federal policy at the White House Office of Management and Budget (2017-2019), then co-founded and served as CTO of restaurant-hall startup Local Kitchens (2020-2023). Co-founded Antares in 2023 with Julia DeWahl.
leaders.why_they_matter: Primary public voice on funding, military contracts, and Antares' stated pivot from proving criticality to selling electricity commercially.

sources.quote: Systems Engineering, Physics, and Statistics from George Mason University and Georgetown University

sources.quote: one-to-one with the taxpayer in bringing this technology to commercial scale

leaders.name: Julia DeWahl
leaders.title: Co-Founder
leaders.background: Studied history at Dartmouth College. Was an angel investor in nuclear companies from 2018 and a nuclear advocate focused on California nuclear policy before co-founding Antares with Jordan Bramble in 2023, where she focuses on supply chain and operations. Her exact current title is disputed across sources: podcast and advocacy-org bios call her only 'co-founder', while some company LinkedIn posts and aggregator sites (theOrg, Craft.co) list 'President' -- not independently confirmed here.
leaders.why_they_matter: Antares' public voice on supply-chain vulnerabilities (graphite, enrichment, Russian uranium dependency) and where the commercial (non-defense) market opens up, distinct from Bramble's funding/defense focus.

sources.label: Mothers for Nuclear — Julia DeWahl profile

leaders.name: Rian Bahran
leaders.title: Chief Nuclear Officer
leaders.background: Holds a Ph.D. in Nuclear Science and Engineering and a dual B.S. in Nuclear Engineering and Engineering Physics, both from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute. Spent over a decade at Los Alamos National Laboratory, then served as a senior advisor to the Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, an assistant director at the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, and most recently as DOE's Deputy Assistant Secretary for Nuclear Reactors. Career member of the Senior Executive Service and recipient of the Secretary of Defense Medal for Exceptional Public Service.
leaders.why_they_matter: A sitting federal advanced-reactor policy official moving directly into a commercial CNO role days after Antares' $470M Series C signals regulatory-world confidence and gives Antares a direct line into DOE reactor policy.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance (BusinessWire) — Dr. Rian Bahran Joins Antares as Chief Nuclear Officer
sources.quote: There is no team I would rather run it with, one that puts its head down and delivers

leaders.name: Mark Massie
leaders.title: Chief Engineer
leaders.background: Holds an S.B. in Nuclear Engineering from the University of Tennessee and an S.M. in Nuclear Engineering from MIT. Co-founded and served as CTO of Transatomic Power, an MIT-spinout molten-salt-reactor startup that ceased operations in 2018, and earlier worked on fuel-composition modeling at TerraPower and sodium-fast-reactor code at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Named to Forbes' '30 Under 30' in energy.
leaders.why_they_matter: Brings prior reactor-startup founder experience -- including the lived experience of a well-funded advanced-reactor startup that failed to reach market -- to Antares' hardware engineering.

leaders.name: Doug Bernauer
leaders.title: Founder & CEO

leaders.name: Rita Baranwal
leaders.title: Chief Nuclear Officer
leaders.background: Holds a B.S. in materials science and engineering from MIT and an M.S./Ph.D. in the same field from the University of Michigan. Held materials-engineering and leadership roles at Bechtel Bettis and Westinghouse (rising to Senior Vice President of the AP300 SMR program), directed Idaho National Laboratory's GAIN initiative starting in 2016, and served as the U.S. Department of Energy's Senate-confirmed Assistant Secretary for Nuclear Energy from July 2019 to January 2021 before joining Radiant as its first Chief Nuclear Officer on June 3, 2025.
leaders.why_they_matter: The most senior former U.S. nuclear regulator/policy official in either company's leadership -- a strong regulatory-credibility signal for licensing Kaleidos.
